method.argmax_tie_rule: Lowest class ID for exact equality; observed max ties = 0
method.ctc_order: First collapse consecutive identical argmax IDs including blanks; then remove blank runs. Never remove blanks before collapsing. A blank-separated repeated label remains repeated.
method.frame_positions: Saved centers, validated equal to global selected-row index*3 for every clip; callback and row indices zero-based
method.frame_time_caution: Frame*0.01 is a model/decoder coordinate, not manually aligned word time or word-tail latency
method.numeric_margin_scope: Subtraction of the JSON-saved decimal values; not recomputation of native FP32 probabilities
method.operations: JSON parse, finite/count/geometry checks, argmax, adjacent-run collapse, blank removal, logit subtraction and descriptive sorting of saved event scores
method.rows_used: All 1144 saved model-output rows, including 33 not searched after callback activation; searched row count is metadata, not replay
